import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["PYTHONWARNINGS"] = "ignore"

# Load data - verify paths from input directory structure
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Prepare features (drop target and ID columns)
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_id = test_df["Id"].copy()

# Check target distribution
unique_classes, counts = np.unique(y_train, return_counts=True)
print(f"\nTarget distribution:")
for cls, count in zip(unique_classes, counts):
    print(f"  Class {cls}: {count:,} samples ({100*count/len(y_train):.1f}%)")

# Create 80-20 validation split using unstratified split due to extreme class imbalance
# Stratification would fail when a class has only 1 member
X_train_part, X_val, y_train_part, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

print(f"\nTraining split: {X_train_part.shape}, Validation: {X_val.shape}")

# Define hyperparameters for LightGBM (removed deprecated 'verbose' parameter)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(np.unique(y_train)),
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train LightGBM on the PARTITIONED training data only (never trains on val)
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params, verbose=-1)
model.fit(X_train_part, y_train_part, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set that was NEVER trained or refit on
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (genuine hold-out): {validation_accuracy:.6f}")

# Save validation metrics before generating predictions
final_validation_metric = validation_accuracy

# Generate predictions on TEST set (only, no refitting)
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file matching sample_submission format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save to required location
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Final summary
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL VALIDATION METRIC (Accuracy): {final_validation_metric:.6f}")
print(f"SUBMISSION FILES: ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"{'='*60}")
